## Checklist
- [ ] I used `templates/tag.md` (or edited an existing page)
- [ ] I gave the number of eVars, props and events needed
- [ ] I used placeholders (like `EVAR_FORM_NAME`), not real eVar or event numbers
- [ ] I tested the code at least once and said how in the QA section
- [ ] I updated the "where to start" table in `docs/index.md` if the counts changed
- [ ] No client names, personal data or real account IDs
